title: उत्तरपर्व · अध्याय १८१

items.text:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
दानान्यन्यानि मे कृष्ण कथयस्व यदूत्तम ॥
मंगल्यानि पवित्राणि सर्वपापहराणि च ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
dānānyanyāni me kṛṣṇa kathayasva yadūttama ||
maṃgalyāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca || 1 ||

items.text:
संसारसागरोत्तारहेतुभूतोऽसि माधव ॥
धर्माधर्मपरिज्ञाने त्वदन्यो नेह कश्चन ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
saṃsārasāgarottārahetubhūto'si mādhava ||
dharmādharmaparijñāne tvadanyo neha kaścana || 2 ||

items.text:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
दानानि बहुरूपाणि कथितानि मया तव ॥
पुनरेव प्रवक्ष्यामि यद्यस्ति तव कौतुकम् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathitāni mayā tava ||
punareva pravakṣyāmi yadyasti tava kautukam || 3 ||

items.text:
कथितानि मया तुभ्यं कथयिष्यामि यानि च ॥
महतार्थेन सिध्यंति प्रयच्छंति महत्फलम् ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
kathitāni mayā tubhyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yāni ca ||
mahatārthena sidhyaṃti prayacchaṃti mahatphalam || 4 ||

items.text:
काम्यो दानविधिः पार्थ क्रियमाणः प्रयत्नतः ॥
फलाय मुनिभिः प्रोक्तो विपरीतो भयाय च ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
kāmyo dānavidhiḥ pārtha kriyamāṇaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
phalāya munibhiḥ prokto viparīto bhayāya ca || 5 ||

items.text:
ज्ञेयं निष्कशतं सर्वदानेषु विधिरुत्तमः ॥
मध्यमस्तु तदर्धेन तदर्द्धेनावरः स्मृतः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ sarvadāneṣu vidhiruttamaḥ ||
madhyamastu tadardhena tadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 6 ||

items.text:
एवं वृक्षरथेंद्राणां धेनोः कृष्णाजिनस्य च ॥
अशक्तस्यापि कृष्टोऽयं पंचसौवर्णिको विधिः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ vṛkṣaratheṃdrāṇāṃ dhenoḥ kṛṣṇājinasya ca ||
aśaktasyāpi kṛṣṭo'yaṃ paṃcasauvarṇiko vidhiḥ || 7 ||

items.text:
अतोऽन्यूनेन यो दद्यान्महादानं नराधिप ॥
प्रतिगृह्णाति वा तस्य दुःखशोकावहं भवेत् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
ato'nyūnena yo dadyānmahādānaṃ narādhipa ||
pratigṛhṇāti vā tasya duḥkhaśokāvahaṃ bhavet || 8 ||

items.text:
आदौ तावत्प्रवक्ष्यामि कालाख्यं पुरुषं तव ॥
सप्तसागरदानं च महाभूतघटन्तथा ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
ādau tāvatpravakṣyāmi kālākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ tava ||
saptasāgaradānaṃ ca mahābhūtaghaṭantathā || 9 ||

items.text:
अर्ध्यप्रदानमंत्रोक्त मात्मप्रतिकृतिस्तथा ॥
सुवर्णाश्वः स्मृतः षष्ठः सुवर्णाश्वरथोऽपरः ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
ardhyapradānamaṃtrokta mātmapratikṛtistathā ||
suvarṇāśvaḥ smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ suvarṇāśvaratho'paraḥ || 10 ||

items.text:
सर्वदानोत्तमं राजन्कृष्णाजिनमथाष्टमम् ॥
विश्वचक्रं च नवमं हैमो गजरथस्तथा ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
sarvadānottamaṃ rājankṛṣṇājinamathāṣṭamam ||
viśvacakraṃ ca navamaṃ haimo gajarathastathā || 11 ||

items.text:
एतत्ते दानदशकं वेद्मि पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
देहि दापय सद्बुदिं दाने नृपनरोत्तम ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
etatte dānadaśakaṃ vedmi pārthivasattama ||
dehi dāpaya sadbudiṃ dāne nṛpanarottama || 12 ||

items.text:
दानादृते नोपकारो विद्यते धनिनोऽपरः ॥
दीयमानो हि नापैति भूय एवाभिवर्धते ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
dānādṛte nopakāro vidyate dhanino'paraḥ ||
dīyamāno hi nāpaiti bhūya evābhivardhate || 13 ||

items.text:
कूप उल्लिख्यमानोऽपि भवत्येव बहूदकः ॥
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य भूमिभागे समे शुभे ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
kūpa ullikhyamāno'pi bhavatyeva bahūdakaḥ ||
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya bhūmibhāge same śubhe || 14 ||

items.text:
चतुर्थ्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां विष्ट्यां वा पांडुनंदन ॥
पुमान्कृष्णतिलैः कार्यो रौप्यदंतः सुवर्णदृक् ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
caturthyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ viṣṭyāṃ vā pāṃḍunaṃdana ||
pumānkṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadaṃtaḥ suvarṇadṛk || 15 ||

items.text:
खड्गोद्यतकरो दीर्णो जपा कुसुमकुंडलः ॥
रक्तांबरधरः स्रग्वी शंखमालाविभूषितः ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrṇo japā kusumakuṃḍalaḥ ||
raktāṃbaradharaḥ sragvī śaṃkhamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 16 ||

items.text:
तीक्ष्णासिपत्रधनुषा विस्फारितकटीतटः ॥
उपानद्युगयुक्तो हि कृष्णकंबल पार्श्वगः ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
tīkṣṇāsipatradhanuṣā visphāritakaṭītaṭaḥ ||
upānadyugayukto hi kṛṣṇakaṃbala pārśvagaḥ || 17 ||

items.text:
गृहीतमांसपिंडश्च वामे करतले तथा ॥
एवं विधं नरं कृत्वा गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
gṛhītamāṃsapiṃḍaśca vāme karatale tathā ||
evaṃ vidhaṃ naraṃ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ || 18 ||

items.text:
संपूज्य गंधकुसुमैर्नैवेद्यं विनिवेद्य च ॥
तिलाज्यं जुहुयात्तत्र त्र्यंबकेति च मंत्रतः ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
saṃpūjya gaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca ||
tilājyaṃ juhuyāttatra tryaṃbaketi ca maṃtrataḥ || 19 ||

items.text:
स्वगृह्योक्तविधानेन शतमष्टोत्तरं यजेत् ॥
यजमानः प्रसन्नात्मा इमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
svagṛhyoktavidhānena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet ||
yajamānaḥ prasannātmā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet || 20 ||

items.text:
सर्वं कलयसे यस्मात्कालस्त्वं तेन भण्यसे ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां त्वमसाध्योऽसि सुव्रत ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
sarvaṃ kalayase yasmātkālastvaṃ tena bhaṇyase ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tvamasādhyo'si suvrata || 21 ||

items.text:
पूजितस्त्वं मया भक्त्या प्रार्थितश्च तथा सुखम् ॥
यदुच्यते तव विभो तत्कुरुष्व नमोनमः ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
pūjitastvaṃ mayā bhaktyā prārthitaśca tathā sukham ||
yaducyate tava vibho tatkuruṣva namonamaḥ || 22 ||

items.text:
एवं संपूजयित्वा तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
ब्रह्माणं प्रथमं पूज्य वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā taṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
brahmāṇaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā || 23 ||

items.text:
दक्षिणां शक्तितो दद्यात्प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत्॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadyātpraṇipatya visarjayet||
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati || 24 ||

items.text:
नापमृत्युभयं तस्य न च व्याधिकृतं भयम् ॥
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः सर्वबाधाविवर्जितः ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhayam ||
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ || 25 ||

items.text:
देहांते सूर्यभवनं भित्त्वा याति परं पदम् ॥
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
संतत्या च श्रिया युक्तः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
dehāṃte sūryabhavanaṃ bhittvā yāti paraṃ padam ||
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ||
saṃtatyā ca śriyā yuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || 26 ||

items.text:
संपूज्य कालपुरुषं विधिवद्द्विजाय दत्त्वा शुभाशुभफलोदयहेतुभूतः ॥
रोगांतरे सकलदोषमये च देही नो वध्यभावमुपगच्छति तत्प्रभावात् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
saṃpūjya kālapuruṣaṃ vidhivaddvijāya dattvā śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtaḥ ||
rogāṃtare sakaladoṣamaye ca dehī no vadhyabhāvamupagacchati tatprabhāvāt || 27 ||

items.h: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिर संवादे कालपुरुषदानविधिवर्णनं नामैकाशीत्युत्तरशततमोध्यायः ।। १८१ ।।

en_summary: Yudhishthira asks for more auspicious gifts that remove sin, since Krishna alone knows dharma and adharma and is the means of crossing the ocean of rebirth. Krishna says the great gifts need much wealth and give great fruit; a gift for a wish, done with care, brings fruit, but done wrongly brings fear. For all gifts the best measure is a hundred nishkas, the middle fifty and the lowest twenty-five, and for trees, chariots, elephants, the cow and the black antelope skin, even one who is poor should use at least five gold pieces; one who gives or takes a great gift with less brings sorrow on himself. He lists ten great gifts: the Kala-purusha (Man of Time), the seven oceans, the jar of the great elements, the arghya gift, the image of oneself, the gold horse, the gold horse chariot, the black antelope skin (best of all), the wheel of the universe and the gold elephant chariot. A rich man has no better use for wealth than giving; given wealth does not shrink but grows, as a well gives more water the more it is dug. He then gives the Kala-purusha: on a holy day, on level ground, on the fourth or fourteenth day or a vishti day, a man is made of black sesame with silver teeth and gold eyes, holding up a sword, fierce, with earrings of red hibiscus, red clothes, garlands and a string of conches, a sharp sword-blade bow at his hip, a pair of sandals, a black blanket at his side and a lump of meat in his left hand. He is worshipped with perfume and flowers and given food, sesame and ghee are offered a hundred and eight times with the "tryambaka" verse, and the patron prays: "Since you measure (kalayase) all things you are called Kala, Time; even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva cannot overcome you; worshipped by me with devotion, grant my wish; homage to you." After honouring the Brahmin with clothes and ornaments, he gives the figure with a fee and bows him away. The giver has no fear of untimely death or disease, enjoys unbroken power free of all troubles, passes through the Sun's world at death to the highest state, and returns as a just king rich in offspring and wealth; worshipping the Man of Time, the cause of good and bad fruit, and giving him to a Brahmin, a person is not killed even by diseases full of every fault.
